answer: Attention Record Requirement lets each agent act only while its recent focused interactions stay inside a bounded window. An identity that idles must wander back and re-earn standing through fresh, filtered work, so operators cannot stockpile cheap dormant accounts. Because every alias needs its own orchard of past exchanges to qualify, an attacker pays sustained attention per identity, not a one-time fee. Sybils thus cost continuous human-equivalent effort, letting the garden of honest agents outgrow fake ones.
